# Move both neo-agent-skills pins to 0.1.16

## Context

`neo-agent-skills` 0.1.16 was published on 2026-09-23 by @tobiu. It carries three merged PRs:

- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#107: seven skill payloads sweep the live corpus instead of the frozen engine mirror.
- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#108: the PR baseline requires exactly one standalone `Resolves` on every PR, drafts included (@tobiu, 2026-09-23: "a PR MUST ALWAYS resolve ONE ticket. zero exceptions.").
- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#110: the commit-authorship pre-push guard no longer refuses a rebased branch for operator-authored commits already on `dev`.

neo still pins 0.1.15 from #19118: `package.json` (plus the lock) and the `pr-baseline.yml` reusable-workflow SHA `fe1a943`.

## The Problem

Until both pins move, neo's PR baseline runs 0.1.15, where a PR body with no close target still passes. Every seat's local pre-push also runs the 0.1.15 authorship guard, which refuses any rebased branch whose new base holds an operator-authored commit. Two sightings today; the 13.1.0 release commit `a987abfb25` on `dev` means every rebase trips it after the 13.2 cut.

## The Architectural Reality

The two pins are separate and must move together, as in #19036 and #19118:

- `package.json` `"neo-agent-skills"`, plus `package-lock.json`: what `npm ci` installs, including the hooks' guards and the materialized `.claude/skills` links.
- `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml`: `uses: neomjs/neo-agent-skills/.github/workflows/reusable-pr-baseline.yml@<sha>`. The workflow at that SHA installs the package version it pins itself.

The 0.1.16 source is `neo-agent-skills` `dev` at `793b580587de226724e28dda7e11391c3e015fda` (the merge of neomjs/neo-agent-skills#110, after #107 and #108). Its reusable workflow pins 0.1.16.

## The Fix

Set `package.json` to `0.1.16` and refresh the lock with `npm install`. Point `pr-baseline.yml` at `793b580587de226724e28dda7e11391c3e015fda`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `package.json` and `package-lock.json` pin `neo-agent-skills` 0.1.16.
- [ ] `pr-baseline.yml` calls the reusable workflow at `793b580587de226724e28dda7e11391c3e015fda`.
- [ ] The PR's own baseline run shows 0.1.16 installed, and its PR-body job applies the close-target check.
- [ ] `npm ci` on the branch leaves the materialized skill links resolving (the baseline's "Skills materialized" job stays green).

## Out of Scope

The other consumers' pins (neo-agent-brain, neo-agent-institution): each moves in its own repository.
